_comment: Approved per-environment RAM1 budgets for the Teensy 4.1 firmware. Edit deliberately, in the same commit as the change that needs it, and record the reason in the owning change's review artifact. Never auto-update from a build. A string value means 'this environment's budget is identical to the named one'.

padding_floor_history.note: Reviewed 32-byte allowance for the accepted-interaction latch: two ITCM call sites to the FLASH-resident predicate inside the ITCM manager entries, plus the latch drive. ITCM stayed at 12 banks; locals free unchanged at 34,944 in teensy41-capture-serial.

teensy41-capture-serial.note: Default capture/acceptance env. Padding 1,096 -> 872 and variables 96,128 -> 96,192 by the restore-liveness A2.1/A2.4 request record: the record stores the full identity + state + terminal per (track, slot), which retires the 64-byte `loopSlotRestoreAttempted_` latch in the same change, and the bounded attempt counter adds 24 B. Padding stays above the 840 floor. Recorded in openspec/changes/deferred-slot-restore-liveness/REVIEW.md.

teensy41.note: Plain env without SESSION_CAPTURE/PERF_TELEMETRY. Same 12-bank ITCM ceiling; padding 9,960 after the same extraction. The shared padding_floor warns if it ever approaches the boundary.
